texts.value: F-actin cross-linking protein which is thought to anchor actin to a variety of intracellular structures. This is a bundling protein
Homodimer; antiparallel. Interacts with Smn; the interaction occurs in adult thoracic tissues
Colocalizes with Smn at the Z-line of indirect flight muscles
Experimental confirmation may be lacking for some isoforms.
Expressed in the larval body wall, adult muscles of the head and abdomen and supercontractile muscles of the larva and adult
Accumulates within adult fibrillar and tubular muscles
